name: Orichalcum Armor
evidence: "If you're wearing armor made of orichalcum, the armor grants you insights into the future, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls."
engineNote: There is no 'initiative' target kind. Initiative is NOT a general Perception check — it is a single roll at the start of an encounter, and in PF2e it can be rolled with a skill (Stealth to Avoid Notice, Deception to Create a Diversion, etc.) instead of Perception. I mapped it to 'perception' because that is the existing precedent in situationalBonuses.ts (see 'all-this-has-happened-before', 'ambush-awareness'), but the honest fix is a dedicated initiative target so the star does not appear on ordinary Perception checks.
